text: Illustration. Another car, earlier in April
Earlier that month, another empty car was stranded in floodwater.
observed: 19.0 to 19.8 s the white car stands still mid-street with water over its wheels; at 19.6 s small amber lamp glows appear at its front and rear corners and remain at 19.8 s. Caption below the car. Small car occupies a narrow band of the frame.
